faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about Synclane pricing and implementation.

pricing.question: How is pricing determined?
pricing.answer: Pricing is based on the number of legal entities, bank connections, and modules required. We work with each customer to build a package that aligns with their treasury complexity and organizational size. Contact our sales team for a tailored quote.

contract.question: Is there a minimum contract?
contract.answer: Our standard agreements are annual contracts. We offer multi-year terms with preferential pricing for organizations that prefer longer commitments. All enterprise contracts include onboarding, training, and ongoing support.

trial.question: Can we start with a trial?
trial.answer: Yes. We offer a guided proof-of-concept period where you can evaluate TiJori with your own data and bank connections. Our implementation team will work with you to ensure a meaningful evaluation within a defined timeframe.

implementation.question: What is included in implementation?
implementation.answer: Every Enterprise contract includes onboarding support, bank connectivity setup, data migration assistance, user training, and a dedicated implementation manager. Enterprise plans include white-glove implementation with custom workflow configuration and extended training. Professional Edition includes priority support and a dedicated onboarding session.

faq.title: Security FAQ
faq.description: Answers to the security and compliance questions we hear most from enterprise treasury teams during evaluation.

encryption.question: How is my data encrypted?
encryption.answer: All data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3. Encryption keys are managed through a dedicated key management service with automatic rotation on a regular schedule. Database-level encryption ensures that even raw storage access cannot expose sensitive treasury data. We also support customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) for organizations that require full key ownership.

storage.question: Where is my data stored?
storage.answer: Synclane offers data residency options across three regions: United States (US-East, US-West), European Union (Frankfurt, Dublin), and Asia-Pacific (Singapore, Sydney). You select your primary region during onboarding, and all data storage and processing remains within that region. This architecture supports compliance with local regulations including GDPR, data sovereignty laws, and internal corporate policies.

incidents.question: How do you handle security incidents?
incidents.answer: Our Security Operations Center monitors systems around the clock using automated threat detection, intrusion detection systems, and anomaly analysis. When a potential incident is identified, our documented incident response plan is activated immediately. Critical incidents are escalated within 15 minutes, affected customers are notified within 72 hours per GDPR requirements, and a post-incident review is conducted and shared with impacted parties. We maintain a public status page for real-time platform health updates.

soc2Report.question: Can we get a copy of your SOC 2 report?
soc2Report.answer: Yes. We provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report to prospective and current customers under a mutual non-disclosure agreement. The report covers security, availability, and confidentiality trust service criteria and is issued annually by an independent third-party auditor. Contact our security team at security@synclane.io or reach out to your account manager to request a copy.

sso.question: Do you support Single Sign-On (SSO)?
sso.answer: Yes. Synclane supports SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) for enterprise Single Sign-On. We integrate with all major identity providers including Okta, Azure Active Directory, Google Workspace, OneLogin, and PingIdentity. SSO is included on all enterprise plans at no additional cost. We also support SCIM for automated user provisioning and deprovisioning to streamline identity lifecycle management.
